name: The High Wilderness
summary: In Feralas, Angelas Moonbreeze worries as Troyas enters the High Wilderness alone. Gordunni ogres hold that ground, and she hopes you can make the ruins southeast of here safer by culling them.

sections.title: Worry for Troyas
sections.body: Angelas Moonbreeze and Troyas explore the scattered ruins of Feralas, though the work is dangerous. Lately, Troyas goes to the High Wilderness alone, and Angelas fears for him. Gordunni ogres hold that ground and welcome no one into their territory. So Angelas asks you to make the ruins southeast of here safer for Troyas by culling eight Gordunni Warlocks, eight Gordunni Shamans and eight Gordunni Brutes.

sections.title: Afterward
sections.body: After you finish the work, Angelas thanks you warmly. She asks you to keep it from Troyas.

faq.q: Who asks you to clear out the High Wilderness?
aliases: who gives the high wilderness quest
faq.answer: Angelas Moonbreeze asks you to clear the High Wilderness. She explores Feralas's ruins with Troyas.

faq.q: Why does Angelas want the Gordunni ogres thinned out?
aliases: why kill ogres in high wilderness
faq.answer: Troyas has been going alone to the High Wilderness, and Angelas worries for him. Gordunni ogres hold the area and welcome no visitors.

faq.q: Where is the High Wilderness ruin?
faq.answer: Angelas points you to the ruins southeast of here.

aliases: who do i kill high wilderness
faq.answer: You are asked to slay eight Gordunni Warlocks, eight Gordunni Shamans and eight Gordunni Brutes.

faq.q: What is said about the Gordunni's magic?
faq.answer: Angelas warns that Gordunni magic seems to ravage the ground beneath them. She bids you stay watchful around the ogres.
